items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Explores China Split As SpaceX Merger Talk Draws Attention
items.summary: Reports indicate Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) has explored separating its China operations to address regulatory and supply chain issues. The proposed structure could support a future merger with SpaceX, although Elon Musk has firmly denied that such a merger is planned. Internal discussions reportedly focus on cross border rules, manufacturing dependencies, and the role of Tesla's China plant in global output.
